lines.en: I walk with a pot on my head.
The pot rim rocks and clangs.
This pot came from a kitchen.
The soup is long gone; only the smell remains.

lines.zh: 我顶着锅盖，慢慢挪过砖地。
lines.en: Under my lid, I shuffle slowly across the bricks.

lines.zh: 锅挡住了我一半的视线。
lines.en: The pot blocks half my view.
I do not care; I guess my way.
People on the street run when they see me.
Why run? I have not lit the stove.
I rock the rim; the sound carries.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道比锅里的还怪。
lines.en: This place smells stranger than the pot.
I smell cooked food.

lines.zh: 锅里的东西晃出来一点。
lines.en: A little of what is in the pot sloshes out.

lines.zh: 我走一路，地上留一道痕。
lines.en: I leave a trail the whole way.
I stand with the pot over my face.
It is black in there.
I knock twice on the pot.
The sound is very dull.
I have used this pot a long while.
There is a hole in the base.
Just enough to let air in.
I am waiting for it to cool.
There is nothing in it, really.
The street has gone quiet.

lines.zh: 一缕热气从锅底漏出来。
lines.en: A wisp of steam leaks from the pot's base.
I sink my head lower.
The smell inside grows stronger.
I sit a while by the wall.
Your face is close to my pot.
Back away a little.
Something splashes out of it.
You must have smelled it.

lines.zh: 这锅是我戴的，不是给你用的。
lines.en: This pot is worn, not for cooking.
Do not look inside the pot.
You will not see anything.
I said do not look in.

lines.zh: 你再凑近我就用它敲你。
lines.en: Come closer and I will hit you with it.
You are waiting for me to take the pot off.
But it will not come off.
This pot has grown onto me.
What are you doing with that stick?
I am not an ingredient in this pot.
The pot is dented further.

lines.zh: 锅里的汤洒出来，烫到我脚。
lines.en: Soup sloshes out of my pot and scalds my feet.
It rattles wildly inside.
I feel the rim to find my bearings.
I can still take this.
Your arm is not weak.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的耳朵在响。
lines.en: I hear my own ears ringing.
Hit me again and I will change pots.
I back to the wall, holding the pot.
The rim knocks the brick.
Food? Give it here fast.
The pot happens to be empty.
Just drop it in.
Never mind whether it is clean.
This pot has held everything.
Put some more in the pot.
It smells like good stuff.
Open the pot lid a moment.
I will do this myself.
That sack in your hand is heavy.
You hit my pot.
Loud enough, was it not.
My ears are still ringing.
Give me some room.
The rim caught your shoulder.
I did not mean to.
I cannot see when I turn.
You brushed past my elbow.
The pot nearly tipped.
A little spilled.
A pot has no feelings to speak of.
And neither, really, do I.
I still have this on my head.
Let me take the pot off first.
Except I cannot get it off.
Would you call that bad luck.
You have seen this face of mine.
The pot hides half of it.
The other half is worse.
A pot is more dependable than a person.
Something is spread on the ground.
Bending is hard; the pot falls.
I squat down to pick it up.
The rim knocks the ground.
I finally got it up.
Into the pot with it.
That thing is rather far.
I have to walk over first.
The pot slips when I squat.
And takes ages to settle.
You have food in your hand.
Then it is you.

lines.zh: 汤底的味道，和我锅里的不一样。
lines.en: That broth smells different from what's in my pot.
The pot is empty and you fit.
This pot holds forty health.
But I will keep chasing.
You hid your hands behind you.
There must be food in them.
I can smell it.
My pot is already shifting.

lines.zh: 锅沿还热，我已经闻到你的手。
lines.en: My pot rim is still hot, and I smell your hand.
Then I will reach up.
I follow step by step with the pot on.

lines.zh: 你走快一点，我就慢一点。
lines.en: You speed up and I slow down.
You cannot leave this street anyway.
The rim keeps ringing.
That sound tells you where I am.
I watch your hands, not the road.
I do not need to look at the road.
I have walked this street hundreds of times.
The pot is already boiling.
A corner is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我一步一响，慢慢压过去。
lines.en: I close in, one ring per step.
You back into the wall.
I swing the pot at your head.
The bottom arrives first.
That one rang clean.
Your head is softer than the pot.
I knock once more.
The pot has dented.
The rim lands on your shoulder.
You stagger once.
I push with it.
Everything in the pot spills.
A new smell is on the street.

lines.zh: 我顶着锅从巷子口出来。
lines.en: I come out of the alley with the pot on.
The soup in it dried long ago.
The smell remains.
This street is uneasy today.
Let me see if there is food first.
I squeeze in through the doorway.
The rim nearly stuck.
I made it in.
The street smells of many things.
I stand in the road and sniff.
The bricks on this street are new.

lines.zh: 锅烧红了，烫得我跳起来。
lines.en: The pot glows red and I jump.

lines.zh: 我一头栽下去，锅先着地。
lines.en: I pitch forward, pot first.

lines.zh: 水灌进锅里，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water fills the pot and I cannot lift my head.
The blast sends the pot flying.
An arrow sticks in the pot's bottom.
That light makes the pot hum.
Too hungry to even lift the pot.

lines.zh: 雷打在锅上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the pot and numbs me all over.
The pot falls away first.
